items.explanation: Hacer has the future stem har-: haré.
optionNotes: Hacer has an irregular stem: har-.
This form does not exist; the stem is har-.

items.prompt: ¿___ a mi fiesta el sábado? (tú, venir)
items.explanation: Venir has the future stem vendr-: vendrás.
optionNotes: Venir has an irregular stem: vendr-.
Vendrá is for él, ella, usted.

items.explanation: After si (if), use the present: si llueve.
optionNotes: After si, Spanish uses the present, not the future.
After si you need a conjugated verb.

items.prompt: Te ___ esta noche, te lo prometo.
items.explanation: Yo form of the future: -é, with an accent: llamaré.
optionNotes: The yo ending is -é, with an accent.
Llamará is for él, ella, usted.
